string.text: Find the documents in the underground lab
There's something behind that door - that's a fact. I need to find the code for that door.
Unlock the door using the code

"...It has to be down there. I can feel the heat rising from that area. Only choice now is to get to the control panel and reset the lockdown. Thank God Arnold Nikolayevich gave me the code - 8620. Fuck, my leg is killing me... I need to sit down and catch my breath."
Open the door to the laboratory
It looks like the door to the laboratory has closed. I need to find the generator.
